confirm.pick: 「作家名」 for artist name (alt. アーティスト名) and ベイカー for Baker (alt. ベーカー).
原子 · 結合 · 殻 · サイクル · 積層 · 四次元 (alt. アトム, シェル, 循環).
ピース for the book's central word (alt. 断片, 部品).
六方性 (h) for hexagonality, so the law is 「六方性の法則」; no fixed Japanese term was found (alt. 六方晶性, ヘキサゴナリティ).
規則 for Rule (半分の規則, 入れ替えの規則) and 法則 for Law, as in the English.
katakana for DICTO's Greek coinages (オグドエコンタヘドロン, ヘカトディヘドロン …) with the face count (八十面体, 百二面体) as a gloss at first use, not as the name.
業の連鎖, 法の球, 菩提の種, 金剛乗; Buddhist piece names 金剛杵, 仏塔, 傘蓋, 印相 (alt. カルマの連鎖, ダルマの球, ヴァジュラ, ストゥーパ).
求心道, the form in Japanese Wikipedia's article on 阿部謙四郎; Otani's reading of kyū as 'sphere' would give 球心道.
AXE, CLEO, FUJI, VAJRA, UNITY, VENUS, DESHI and ATOM kept in Latin capitals with a katakana reading; and is DESHI meant as 弟子?
アンボーン (alt. 不生 or 無生, the Buddhist 'unborn'; the local model's choice was 無生).
モンキー・スタッフ (alt. 如意棒, the Monkey King's staff).
translated: 盾 (Shield), 提督帽 (Admiral Cap), 宝冠 (Diadem), 冠の宝珠 (Crown Jewel), 内なる目 (Inner Eye), 楔 · 針 (Dodeca-13 pieces); the other option is katakana for all.
蓮の実 for the Lotus seed but ロータス in the Jewel family (ロータス・ジュエル, ロータス・ジュエル・アックス).
ラデリ, the syllables of デリラ swapped as Sonsam = ソンサム swaps サムソン (alt. ラーデリ).
the official Japanese titles of the Kansho Exhibition, the Kyoto Takasegawa Art Festival and Interdependent Origination III (縁起 III?).

sources_checked: Japanese Wikipedia, titles reached through the English Wikipedia language links (about 230 English articles queried on 31 October 2026), and these Japanese pages read in full or in part: 半正多面体 (for 半正多面体 vs 準正多面体), 星型正多面体, 正六百胞体, 空間充填, グノモン, 双対多面体, 球充填, 切頂五胞体, 多胞体, 菱形十二面体第2種, 正五角錐反柱, 炭化ケイ素, 阿部謙四郎.
Existence checks on Japanese Wikipedia for about 160 candidate titles (e.g. 準正多面体 redirects to 半正多面体; no pages for 菱形六十面体, 黄金菱面体, 600胞体, 結晶多形, 四面体空隙).
Mitsubishi Electric, SiC lecture series 3, 『SiC の結晶構造とエネルギーバンド』 (積層, 積層順, ポリタイプ, 積層欠陥, 最稠密).
Kyoto University (Tsuiki), notes on the truncated 600-cell model (切頂六百胞体).

Web searches (31 October 2026): 「六方晶性」 ポリタイプ; 「六方性」 SiC; 「ヘキサゴナリティ」 OR 「六方晶度」; SiC 4H 六方晶性 50%; 阿部謙四郎 求心道; rectified 600-cell in Japanese. None gave a fixed Japanese word for hexagonality or for rectified.
English Wikipedia, Kyūshindō and Kenshiro Abbe (Otani's reading; the three principles).

Second opinion: the local model (Qwen3.5-35B workhorse on dicto-big-brother; gpt-oss-120b was not running as a service) on 26 items; taken where it agreed with the checked usage (業の連鎖, 法の球, 菩提の種), set aside where it was wrong (e.g. 余角形 for gnomon, 整流 for rectified).
